heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 96–465, title II, § 2205(1), Oct. 17, 1980, 94 Stat. 2159

notes.text: Section, acts Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title IV, § 441, 60 Stat. 1005; Sept. 8, 1960, Pub. L. 86–723, § 5, 74 Stat. 831, related to classification of positions in Service and in Department.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Feb. 15, 1981, except as otherwise provided, see section 2403 of Pub. L. 96–465, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3901 of this title.

notes.heading: Rules Governing Salary Determinations for Initial Classification
notes.text: Act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title XI, § 1105, 60 Stat. 1034, which related to applicability of rules for salary determinations for initial classification, was repealed by Pub. L. 96–465, title II, § 2205(1), Oct. 17, 1980, 94 Stat. 2159.
